Hello @la-lisa 

Your issue is duplicate of this one #23025
And as you can see in this comment https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/23025#issuecomment-768980463 I didn't manage to reproduce the issue.
Please check and feedback.

Thanks!

As described above, it happens under certain circumstances when in the database the query` SELECT (MAX(number) + 1) AS new_number`, returns the same value. E.g. if the operations for the two different orders are executed almost at the same time, or one takes a little longer. 
It's hard to recreate this problem under artificial circumstances, but we have this problem every month with a customer with a lot of orders - this is a privacy issue and needs to be fixed somehow. The issue exists and is not due to another module - we crosschecked it on a clean PS1.7.8.6 instance and the issue is there too.

I can attach you a screenshot with the duplicated order numbers - but that will not help to reproduce the issue!

Hello @la-lisa 

> The issue exists and is not due to another module - we crosschecked it on a clean PS1.7.8.6 instance and the issue is there too.

So, could you please provide a clear and concise steps to reproduce the issue and a screen record :pray: 
Waiting for your feedback.

Thanks!

Steps:
1. Customer 1 hits the "Place Order" Button in the Checkout - Order is placed in the backend (page is loading - payment actions are taken)
2. Customer 2 hits the button during the loading Page of Customer 1 and his Order is placed and payment loads
3. Customer 1 can view his Invoice - he sees the right one
4. Customer 2 can view his Invoice - he sees the invoice of customer 1 because the invoice number ("number" colum in ps_order_invoice) is the same for both orders

Or:
1. Customer 1 hits the "Place Order" Button in the Checkout - Order is placed in the backend (page is loading - payment actions are taken)
2. Employee of shop owner changes the status of a wirepayment order of Customer 2 during the page loading of customer 1, to "Payment Accepted" and an Invoice is generated.
3. Customer 1 can view his Invoice - he sees the right one
4. Customer 2 can view his Invoice - he sees the invoice of customer 1 because the invoice number ("number" colum in ps_order_invoice) is the same for both orders

I will try to capture it in a screen recording the next week.

But as more people were reporting this same issue already, I think this is not only a problem of our system.

I've seen this occurs, two invoices (different orders) having same number. Both invoices are generated at the same moment (same date_add), so I guess the query to obtain the current max number returned same value... Yeah, it's a great coincidence, but in a shop with a lot of orders maybe it occurs.

In the shop I'm talking about there are 7 duplicated invoice number in the last 7 months, so an average of 1 per month. Invoices with same number were generated at the same time. This is not a joke.

I take this opportunity to comment that the billing management in PrestaShop is painful, it drags things wrong from very old versions.

@josecarlosphp unfortunatelly the issue was again closed by prestashop. Because the issue is not that easy to reproduce - but i also have more than 10 duplicated invoice numbers in our shop. Which is a very big issue, especially for data security.

In this case there are 3 invoices with the same ID and delivery note (client data is OK, issue is just regarding the invoice ID and the delivery note) but each order was placed in different days (13, 14 and 15 January 2023) and they are not correlative (first order is 2373, second is 2374 but the third one is 2376).

This is not a a module problem. I'm checking other websites from my clients with versions from 1.7.6.5 to 1.7.7.8 and all of them are suffering this critical (due to finance regulations) problem. There are sites without common modules and with different themes affected by this bug.

Please, priorize this. This is not a joke and can have a high negative impact in bussiness accounting.

Hello i come with a way to reproduce easily !

From ANY version of Prestashop from 1.7.7.2 (mine) and 8.0.*

In method `setLastInvoiceNumber` in
`classes\order\Order.php`

The request is following :
`SELECT new_number FROM (SELECT (MAX(number) + 1) AS new_number`

Its atrocious way to find the last available number because this method don't lock any other process concurrent executing an order integration at the same time to get the SAME maximum number.

For reproduce, you just can put here, before executing the insert request, a `sleep()` juste before the `Db::getInstance()->execute($sql)`. When you validate the first order the sleep start, and then, validate another order in same time. The two order validation get the same maximum number....

This case is occured in production for my company !

We patched our prestashop by overriding `setLastInvoiceNumber` with a request who select in a created separate sequence
`CREATE SEQUENCE ps_sequence_invoice_number START WITH 100000;`

AND get next number by
`SELECT NEXT VALUE FOR ps_sequence_invoice_number;`

Any hope to see a fix of this kind in Prestashop base code ?
A good system for locking invoice number...

Same problem here. 19 double invoice numbers in one year. All cases were created on orders at the exact same time. I hope this security and privacy issue will be solved by building an extra condition. Any news about this bug?

To anyone who will try to use this method, please be aware that SEQUENCES instruction is not natively supported on MySQL 5.6. You need at least MySQL 8.0.3, or MariaDB 10.3 to use this instruction.
